intent: Dim visitor hall, independently illuminated exhibits, restrained construction fill.
limitations: Materials are mixed: shaded fish surfaces, substrate and architecture respond to the lights; unshaded source-art props retain their authored colors.
Two bounded spotlights per tank, one shadow caster. No volumetric beams, realtime global illumination or simulated glass refraction.
Guide markers are low self-lit fixtures; room readability also uses restrained ambient fill.
